mo_ta_cong_viec:
Oivan is seeking a full-time passionate Ruby on Rails Developers (Middle/Senior) to join our growing Ho Chi Minh City and Danang teams. 
 
We offer the unique opportunity to work and improve your skills with a diverse and geographically distributed team of technology and business experts around the world. We have offices in Helsinki (Finland), Khon Kaen (Thailand), Bangkok (Thailand), Abu Dhabi (UAE), Riyadh (KSA) and Vietnam.  
 
Our project team uses the Scrum framework via Scrum.org certified Professional Scrum Masters. 
 
We have hybrid work options with open culture and Nordic management style. Our Nordic spirit and values drive the way we work always.
